notes.title: Patch Update One
notes.notes:
Hi all, I am pushing out an update to resolve immediate front facing issues/bugs and to apply some changes after player feedback. I hope this makes for a better experience for all



Fix for pistol shooting at incorrect angle

Increase shotgun damage accordingly

Increase weapon damage after upgrade

Decrease Price of locations and upgrades

Changes to map to reduce restrictiveness

General bug fixes to prevent map exploits

notes.title: Release Day For Slayer Soon!
notes.notes:
Introduction! 
Hey Everyone, my name is Skittlez! Im the creator of this game and I just wanted to say thank you to everyone who has been so supportive and wish listed my indie game so far, it means a lot to me. I just wanted to make this post to connect with you guys as I really want to make this an enjoyable experience and improve the game for those who like it as I know we can be pretty critical of games even if they are just indie.  I will start of by saying that I am primarily just a programmer, and yes that is something I am working on to expand into other things. So while yes there are paid assets in this game, I have done my best to utilise the core mechanics, functionality and gameplay of everything I have added to make up for that. I hope people enjoy the game for what it is, being a solo indie game.

 What else to expect! 
As I mentioned I really want to improve and develop the game further for those who enjoy it once I get feedback from everyone about it. I have also done my best to test/play the game to find and fix as many bugs as I could find. But know how games are, there will always be a hidden bug somewhere :D I have setup a community Discord server where issues and bugs can be posted so that I am aware of them and can fix things that come up. So I will be looking to continue working on the game after release to not only fix any issue, but add more content. 

 To end things of 
Again thanks everyone for the support so far, and cant wait to see you all in the game!
